blocks.content: This scenario is the same as the fractional knapsack problem where you're in a MrBeast video, and he will buy you all the items you can fit into a knapsack.
The only difference is that instead of items that can be taken at a fraction, like wheat, oil, and gold bars, we have the following set of items.
The capacity of the knapsack is 35 units.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
